records.canonicalEnglish: Insert the {disk} Disk in drive {drive}, then press any key.

context.intent: Identify the requested disk and drive; preserve dynamic substitution.
notes: Disk labels match image names, including Opening. Seven-cell labels use a separate resident pool.

review.note: Reviewed both dynamic instructions and all six labels against image names; Opening is spelled in full. Technical adaptation keeps drive numbers explicit.

notes: Seven-cell name copies; dual prompt preserves the 35-byte row stride. Disk noun is implicit.
